title: rigor: automated playground benchmark
description: Create a benchmark suite to measure LatticeEngine latency across a range of requirement volumes (10 to 1000). Ensure linear scalability.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain high performance under load.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL report ms per requirement parsed.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT be considered release-ready

postconditions: Benchmark results are persisted to docs/benchmarks/
invariants: The benchmark does not modify project state

title: rigor: documentation clarity architectural doctrine
description: Finalize the comprehensive architecture guide covering the Functional Core, Typestate Sessions, and Quality Algebra.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL be fully documented for future maintainers.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL include the unified structural blueprint.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT pass documentation review
unwanted.because: rigor requires adherence to established doctrine.

invariants: Documentation matches the current code implementation 100%

phase_1: Sync diagrams with final module tree

title: rigor: verify zero dead code
description: Use cargo-deadlinks and cargo-unused-features to ensure no legacy code or unused dependencies remain after flattening.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL be minimal and efficient.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN dead code analysis is run
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL identify orphaned structs and functions.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT pass final release check
unwanted.because: dead code increases binary size and maintenance surface.

title: rigor: release closeout and cleanup
description: Perform final cleanup of the workspace, including deletion of migration scripts, test artifacts, and temporary task files.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL be production-ready and clean.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL purge all non-source artifacts.

unwanted.condition: IF temporary JSON files are committed
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT be considered a clean release

invariants: The project builds from a fresh clone without extra files

title: rigor: epic closeout
description: Formally close the Epic oya-lf6 after verifying all child beads and architectural invariants are satisfied.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL record the successful completion of major milestones.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN all child tasks are closed
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL close the Epic.

unwanted.condition: IF any child task remains open
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow Epic closeout

preconditions: All beads in oya-lf6 are closed
invariants: The project has reached the target architecture state
